title: Where Backtests and Live Trading Part Ways: Six Defects from One Intraday System
abstract: arXiv:2610.21846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Backtests of intraday strategies can drift away from what the live system actually does; in our case, the drift never showed in summary statistics. We report six defects found while running one intraday US equity system live and comparing its live days with their backtest replay. Three came from data: a default feed that carried a small fraction of real opening volume, historical prices adjusted for dividends that live orders never see, and data the live system downloaded but the backtest never did. Two came from code: a sizing step that exceeded a limit the live account enforces, and UTC timestamps read as New York time. One came from configuration: settings that were switched on but never reached the code that places orders. For each we give the symptom, the size of the error, the cause and the test or control that now guards against it. All six sat where two paths that should agree had drifted apart. translated_title: 回测与实盘交易的分道扬镳之处：来自一个日内交易系统的六个缺陷
translated_abstract: 日内策略的回测结果可能会偏离实盘系统的实际表现；在我们的案例中，这种偏差从未在汇总统计数据中显现。我们报告了在实盘运行一个美股日内交易系统、并将实盘交易日与其回测重放进行对比的过程中发现的六个缺陷。其中三个来自数据：默认数据源仅携带真实开盘成交量的一小部分、实盘订单从未使用过经股息调整的历史价格，以及实盘系统下载了但回测从未使用过的数据。两个来自代码：一个仓位计算步骤超出了实盘账户强制执行的限额，以及UTC时间戳被误读为纽约时间。一个来自配置：已开启但从未传达至下单代码的设置项。针对每个缺陷，我们都给出了症状、错误规模、成因，以及当前用于防范该问题的测试或控制措施。这六个缺陷全都出现在本应一致的两条执行路径产生分歧的地方。最后，我们给出了一个包含十项内容的检查清单。
tldr: 本文通过将一个美股日内交易系统的实盘运行与其回测重放对比，发现了六个导致两者偏差的缺陷——三个源于数据、两个源于代码、一个源于配置，并为每个缺陷提供了症状、错误规模、成因及防范措施。
en_tdlr: By running an intraday US equity system live and comparing it against backtest replays, this paper identifies six defects—three from data, two from code, and one from configuration—that caused backtests to diverge from live trading, detailing the symptom, error magnitude, root cause, and safeguard for each.
